description: This file defines a service class 'CreateOrderFromCartFlow' which orchestrates the checkout flow in an e-commerce system. It handles retrieving cart data, validating it, reserving inventory, calculating prices and taxes, quoting and selecting shipping options, creating orders, and authorizing payments. It manages the entire checkout process including error handling for various failure modes, and references numerous external clients and data transfer objects.

classes.name: CreateOrderFromCartFlow
classes.description: Main service class orchestrating the entire checkout flow, including cart validation, inventory reservation, pricing, tax calculation, shipping, order creation, and payment authorization.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to run the checkout flow, returning a CheckoutResult or throwing exceptions.

methods.name: quoteAndSelectShippingOrThrow
methods.description: Handles quoting available shipping options and selecting an appropriate quote based on the request.

methods.name: selectQuoteOrThrow
methods.description: Selects a shipping quote from available options, either using the provided selection or choosing the cheapest.

methods.name: validateCartMatchesRequest
methods.description: Validates that the cart matches the request parameters.

methods.name: reserveInventoryOrThrow
methods.description: Reserves inventory for each cart item, throwing if reservation fails.

methods.name: mapCartToCreateOrder
methods.description: Maps cart response data to create order request objects.

methods.name: calculateSubtotal
methods.description: Calculates subtotal price by resolving price for each cart item.

methods.name: resolveUnitPriceOrZero
methods.description: Resolves unit price for a product SKU or returns zero if unavailable.

methods.name: normalizeStoreCode
methods.description: Normalizes store code string, defaults to 'DEFAULT'.

methods.name: stableStoreIdLong
methods.description: Generates a deterministic long ID from store UUID for compatibility with tax service.

methods.name: authorizePaymentOrThrow
methods.description: Handles payment authorization via external payment client, throwing on failure.

methods.name: buildPaymentIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Builds a consistent idempotency key for payment requests.

methods.name: toMinorUnitsOrThrow
methods.description: Converts a BigDecimal amount to minor units (long), throwing if conversion is not exact.
